topic: Am I Ready for a ChemE Job? Perspectives of a Senior ChemE Student
title: Am I Ready for a ChemE Job? Perspectives of a Senior ChemE Student
session_title: Am I Ready for a ChemE Job? Perspectives of a Senior ChemE Student
abstract: If you've ever wondered, like me, if the classes you take every semester are enough to get a job out there in the vast chemical engineering industry, you're not alone. In this workshop we'll talk about what the current market needs and expects us to know once we graduate. We'll discuss what skills are sought, what additional knowledge you can provide and what bonus activities can make you stand out to have a higher chance of getting that job you want. All from the perspective of a senior ChemE student.
